rule: live = provider-designated public cloud region/AZ in-country; announced = country named, not live; closed = shut down. Secondary sources only: no provider sites, .cn domains or PRC state media were fetched. Partner/JV-run regions counted as live with a note.

notes: UK CONFLICT: tasking cited an Alibaba UK closure; no secondary source found reporting one. DCD 2018 confirms London launch and TechRepublic (2026-06-18) describes UK as existing Alibaba European infrastructure. Recorded as live; flag for review rather than assumed closed.
Alibaba closures confirmed only for India (Mumbai, 15 Jul 2024) and Australia (Sydney, 30 Sep 2024) per The Register.
Alibaba NLD planned go-live October 2026; not confirmed live as of 2026-10-20 -> 'announced'. Re-verify next run.
Alibaba BRA (Aug 2026) and FRA (Jun 2026): reported launched/operational via secondary reports of provider announcements; BRA reports do not explicitly confirm GA.
Alibaba SAU is operated via SCCC (JV with STC), i.e. partner-operated; JPN originally via SB Cloud (SoftBank JV). Both counted as Alibaba-designated regions.
Alibaba THA: DCD describes a Bangkok data center with one AZ, not explicitly a 'region'; counted live.
Tencent SAU: Feb 2025 'launch' announcement, Sept 2025 Arab News said not yet live, Mar 2026 DataCentre News UK says two AZs launched in 2025 -> live, moderate confidence.
Tencent JPN: Osaka (third Japan AZ) announced Apr 2025; Osaka go-live not verified (Japan already live via Tokyo).

Tencent IND (Mumbai, opened 2018), Tencent RUS (Moscow, 600 racks at IXcellerate 2018-19) and Huawei RUS (Moscow, 500 rented racks, 2019): current status could not be verified by any 2024-2026 secondary source; omitted rather than guessed. Tencent's DCD Feb 2025 region list names Silicon Valley, Virginia, Toronto, Frankfurt, São Paulo but not Moscow or Mumbai (Asia list not given). Recommend research_gap records.

Tencent BHR: March 2021 announcement of first MENA 'internet data centre' in Bahrain (per Verdict 2021); Tencent later called Saudi its 'first Middle East region', so Bahrain is not treated as a region. Omitted.
Tencent MYS: 2024 Cyberjaya 'Alto Cloud' DC with GRM (Wikipedia) is a partner facility, not a Tencent region; only the Aug 2026 Johor region is counted.

Huawei MYS: Technology Magazine (Aug 2025) says Huawei Cloud has 'five regions and 17 AZs across ASEAN' without naming them; named ASEAN regions found are SGP, THA, IDN, PHL (four). No source names a Malaysian Huawei region - omitted; possible gap.
Huawei KEN: ITWeb Africa (Sep 2024) says Kenya has only a PoP linked to Johannesburg, not a region. Omitted.
Huawei FRA / DEU: no Huawei-designated region found (Open Telekom Cloud is a Deutsche Telekom service, not a Huawei region). Omitted.
Huawei 'since' years mostly null: region lists (DCD 2023/2024) confirm existence but not launch dates for SGP, THA, IDN, TUR, IRL, MEX, BRA, CHL, ARG, PER, HKG.
Several since-years for Alibaba (HKG 2014, MYS 2017, IDN 2018 corroborated by DCD, PHL 2021, USA 2015) rely on Wikipedia as confirmation; treat as lower confidence.
Capacity Media Alibaba articles (Singapore/US/Dubai/Frankfurt/Japan; Philippines) carry no visible publication date; date recorded as null.
Some sources (aap.com.au cision releases) are wire copies of provider press releases -> S4; used only alongside S2 reporting.
SCMP (Alibaba-owned) appeared in search results but was not used as a source.
